title: A model-backed engine records the model it used in the Reproducibility Envelope
rationale: Deliberately scoped to the model tiers. It is the suite’s demonstration that a vector outside the adapter’s declared tier reports SKIPPED and never PASSED: a rule-based engine has no model to record, and crediting it with this requirement would misstate what it was tested for.

requirement.text: The envelope’s model member is REQUIRED whenever a model is used, with weight hashes recorded where obtainable.

priorities.rationale: I want to notice who keeps data on the device.

content.title: School districts weigh where student data lives

blocks.text: The district is piloting local-first software that keeps student records on classroom machines rather than in a vendor cloud.
An internal review found that 73 percent of teacher laptops were missing critical updates at the start of the school year.
A state audit published in 2024 found gaps in vendor contracts, with 40 districts affected according to the published report.
